name: luxury-mediterranean-look-back
image_purpose: travel lifestyle social content and vacation profile visual

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic high-fashion lifestyle photograph of an adult woman on a luxury Mediterranean terrace overlooking a coastal town and blue ocean.
prompt.main_subject: One adult woman with long wavy blonde hair, soft original facial features, and an elegant relaxed expression. She wears a black-and-white polka-dot one-piece swimsuit, white ankle-strap high-heeled sandals, and dark sunglasses, and holds a magazine at her side. Keep the magazine cover blank or unreadable.
prompt.composition_elements: Show the adult woman standing on a luxury terrace seen mostly from behind and looking back over her shoulder toward the camera. Include a striped lounger, Mediterranean balcony, coastal town, and blue ocean in the background. Use a relaxed luxury-vacation composition with the subject separated from a softly focused environment.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural summer daylight with soft shadows, clean blue coastal tones, warm neutral terrace materials, and a relaxed elegant luxury-vacation mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic DSLR-style portrait, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field with soft background focus, high-detail hair and fabric texture, natural anatomy, bright daylight, no readable text or watermark.
